exercises.prompt: Select the correct 2ms imperative derived from تَجْلِسْ ('sit!').
exercises.explanation: Because the middle radical vowel of تَجْلِسْ is kasrah (-i-), the prosthetic hamzat al-waṣl takes kasrah: اِجْلِسْ.

feedback.rule: Prosthetic hamzat al-waṣl takes ḍammah only when the middle radical has ḍammah; otherwise it takes kasrah.

exercises.prompt: True or False: In Form I imperatives like اُكْتُبْ, the initial alif is hamzat al-qaṭʿ and is always pronounced even after وَ.
exercises.explanation: False. Form I imperatives begin with hamzat al-waṣl, which elides after وَ (وَاكْتُبْ = wa-ktub).

feedback.rule: Form I imperatives carry hamzat al-waṣl.
